input_rationale.evolution: The additive objective controls preserve the existing default but have no upstream maintenance history yet.
input_rationale.locality: Implementation is confined to GRPOStrategy, CLI strategy arguments, focused tests, documentation, and benchmark evidence.
input_rationale.tests: The complete local suite passed 635 tests with 103 environment-dependent skips; 26 focused tests passed on NVIDIA L20 GPU5.
input_rationale.failure: Non-finite or invalid clip bounds, unsupported aggregation modes, incomplete overlong windows, and invalid penalty scales fail explicitly.
input_rationale.contract: Implementation, tests, documentation, benchmark tooling, and raw L20 output are digest-bound, but the artifact is not sealed or maintainer-reviewed.
input_rationale.integration: All options flow through the existing train CLI strategy_kwargs boundary into offline and online GRPO without a parallel strategy implementation.
input_rationale.interface: Unset clip bounds inherit the symmetric epsilon, token aggregation remains the default, and soft-overlong shaping is opt-in.
input_rationale.lifecycle: Reward shaping creates a new tensor before group normalization and does not mutate reward-model output or rollout cache state.
input_rationale.buildtest: The full local suite, focused L20 suite, Ruff checks, and InfraSWE engine tests passed.
input_rationale.policy: No dependency is added and the PR explicitly excludes dynamic sampling rather than approximating its refill semantics.
input_rationale.attainment: Default objective values exactly match baseline in all measured cases and default median latency shows no regression.
input_rationale.coverage: The probe spans batch/group 4x8 and 8x8 with response lengths from 256 to 4096, and tests cover formula, validation, masks, backward, CLI, and online integration.
input_rationale.retention: Default symmetric clipping and token aggregation retain prior behavior while all existing regressions pass.
input_rationale.family: The options reuse GRPOStrategy for offline and online rollout paths and expose both original-GRPO and DAPO reductions.
input_rationale.compile: The objective changes introduce no compilation step and do not compile during timed operations.
input_rationale.replay: Each L20 case uses 20 warmups and 100 timed iterations, but five independent fresh-process runs were not performed.
input_rationale.load: The L20 probe executes the real tensor objective shapes, but excludes model forward/backward and downstream reward-quality evaluation.
input_rationale.resource: Only the explicitly available GPU5 was used; all other users' GPU processes and containers were left untouched.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Warm objective latency is measured; end-to-end cold startup and long training stability are outside this evidence.
